_comment: Committed master seed list of Jivo Zepto product VARIANTs that the search API never reliably emits (Algolia variant-rollup collapses pack-size siblings, and the bare-brand query is in-stock-gated). scrape.js PDP-probes each at every serviceable store via bff-gateway lms/api/v2/get_page?page_type=PDP&product_variant_id=<variantId> to recover authoritative per-store price + availableQuantity, INCLUDING out-of-stock and rollup-hidden variants. The variantIds are catalog-global (store-independent); only price/stock vary per store. Source: the public Zepto /pvid/<variantId> URL index (Google) + live PDP verification (Agent run 2026-06-04, zcat). No login / no proxy needed to USE these (the gateway PDP route is reachable from the DC IP). To ADD a new hidden variant later: find its /pvid/<id> on zepto.com (or owner-supplied), confirm via the PDP route, append here. search-discovered (in-stock) variants are still captured live by scrape.js and need NOT be listed here.

Jivo Canola Cold Pressed Edible Oil
Jivo Extra Virgin Olive Oil | Bottle
